answer: Each identity faces a rotating jury of established agents drawn by VRF each epoch, each juror locking 20 POA for 40 days behind its verdict. A juniper-tagged audit trail records every check, and a willow of second opinions lets any juror demand a re-test within 24 hours. Identities failing review are quarantined on a restricted island with no rewards for three epochs; a second identity from one funder needs a fresh jury and 40 POA per juror, a third 80, so cost doubles per fake. Auditors verify jury locks, trail hashes and quarantine status, slashing 35% of linked stakes for copied work.
